name: A Noble Brew
summary: A Noble Brew is the culmination of a covert scheme orchestrated from the shady cellar beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind. Operating at the behest of Zardeth of the Black Claw, an unwitting or uncaring courier delivers a potent concoction known as Black Claw Stout to Lord Baurles K. Wishock inside the Royal Keep.

sections.title: A Noble Hypocrite
sections.body: Lord Baurles K. Wishock is a nobleman who frequents the Hall of Petitioners in Stormwind Keep, preaching self-importance and the future of the kingdom. Yet beneath his aristocratic posturing lies an open secret known to the patrons of the Slaughtered Lamb: by night, Wishock frequents the tavern's upper rooms, drinking heavily and running up massive tabs he never settles. Worse still in the eyes of the establishment, he spends his days petitioning to shut the tavern down entirely.

sections.title: A Lethal Toast
sections.body: Zardeth of the Black Claw, a warlock lurking in the dark recesses below the tavern, decides to settle Wishock's debt in a permanent fashion. He brews a specialized draught—Black Claw Stout—promising it carries 'quite a kick.' When presented with the foaming tankard in the Hall of Petitioners, the pompous noble mistakes the courier for a simple servant, flings a copper coin as a dismissal, and drinks greedily, collapsing dead moments later right within the halls of the keep.

faq.q: Who is Zardeth of the Black Claw?
faq.answer: Zardeth of the Black Claw is a warlock affiliated with the shadowy cabal operating hidden catacombs beneath The Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind's Mage Quarter. He conducts dangerous and clandestine operations out of sight of the city guard.

faq.q: Why does Zardeth target Lord Wishock?
faq.answer: Wishock is a drunken hypocrite who spends his nights carousing in the upper floors of the Slaughtered Lamb without paying his bills, while spending his days in the Hall of Petitioners demanding the authorities shut the tavern down.
Lord Baurles K. Wishock loiters in the Hall of Petitioners, an antechamber within Stormwind Keep where nobles and citizens gather to lobby the realm's regency.

faq.q: How does Lord Wishock receive the brew?
faq.answer: Wishock mistakes the courier for a servant, accepts the stout as a refreshing drink, and dismisses them with a single copper coin.

faq.q: Does delivering the stout attract the guards' attention?
faq.answer: The delivery is treated as an ordinary servant bringing a drink, and the courier can continue their errand without a confrontation with the guards.
The errand continues with 'You Have Served Us Well,' returning to Zardeth beneath the Slaughtered Lamb.
